appDescription: Displays local driving simulation analysis, measured simulation metrics and setup candidates for comparison.

function.name: SHOW_LATEST_RECOMMENDATION
function.description: Read the latest local simulation setup recommendation and its validity status.

function.name: EXPLAIN_RECOMMENDATION
function.description: Explain the observations supporting the latest simulated setup candidate.

function.name: SHOW_SESSION_METRICS
function.description: Read the latest simulated lap times, pedal inputs, accelerations and suspension metrics.
